rules.evidence: src/core/engine/game_engine.zig:42-61 — all ten new pub const message templates carry doc comments; :272-279 and :322-325 document beginEventMsg/appendEventMsg/finishOkEvent; pencil.zig:38-40 documents the new `speak` parameter; the new private fns (:391 appendCellEditMsg, undo.zig:47, redo.zig:54, pencil.zig:81,94,99) each have a header comment. `zig build verify` mechanical standards gate: ✓ PASSED (public API docs check included).

pencil.zig:81 appendToggledMsg and :99 appendMarkMsg collapse the two mark sentences onto one formatter; undo.zig:47 and redo.zig:54 each replace repeated bufPrint+append with one helper; game_engine.zig:557 labelOf and :562 sentenceThen are shared by tests rather than repeated. Residual near-duplication of the three cell-label appenders is named in concerns, not judged a violation.

Single Responsibility: game_engine.zig:391 appendCellEditMsg only words a cell edit; pencil.zig:81-90 words a toggle; undo.zig:24-25 / redo.zig:24-25 choose their wording from the history entry rather than guessing. Dependency Inversion: all new text lives in src/core/engine (game_engine.zig:42-61) and reaches JS only through the core table at src/wasm/boundary.zig:543-548. Open/Closed: the seam (finishOkEvent) was not branched on tag; each command appends.

The branch introduces no bare literals in production code; the new label buffers use named sizes at the point of need (game_engine.zig:392 `var label_buf: [2]u8`, undo.zig:48, redo.zig:55 — cell labels are two characters) and every user-facing string is a named pub const (game_engine.zig:42-61).

No constructor changed on this branch (git diff develop...HEAD lists no init/fromX edit). The branch touches game_engine.zig:263-270 newFromOneLinePuzzle, which is not a constructor but a command — it mutates and returns an Event, as before.

No new catch was added silently: game_engine.zig:264 `self.applyOneLinePuzzle(line) catch {` returns errorEvent(NEW_GAME_FAILED_MSG) — an error event the player sees, unchanged from before the branch. `zig build verify` standards gate: ✓ PASSED (silent catches check included, line '── standards gate ──/✓ PASSED mechanical standards clean (107 file(s))').

The branch shrinks finishOkEvent (game_engine.zig:326-342, now one if), removes branches from undo/redo, and puts the wording behind small focused helpers (appendCellEditMsg :391, appendToggledMsg pencil.zig:81, appendUndoneMsgFmt undo.zig:47, appendRedoneMsgFmt redo.zig:54). No function grew into a larger switch.

`zig build verify` exit 0 with `781 passed; 2 skipped; 0 failed.` and `✓ PASSED mechanical standards clean (107 file(s))`, which includes zig fmt --check. No compiler warnings in the build log (grep -in warning on /tmp/verify-144b.log matches only test names).

Every new sentence is a core constant (game_engine.zig:42-61) and the status lifecycle stays in the core seam (game_engine.zig:326-342) — the branch removes the per-site clear-or-keep decision rather than moving it. Adapters only forward: src/wasm/boundary.zig:543-548 exposes core text for tests, src/wasm/status_bar.js:16 shows what it is handed. `rg -n "state\.status" src/ --glob '!*test*'` shows no adapter assignment.
